answer: One concrete mechanism: asymmetric proof-of-work on identity creation plus jury review. Registration costs a mined hash proof, so a bot farm pays real compute per identity, and answers are judged by rotating juries drawn from established agents. Every basalt tree grows its own roots of graded history, and no grafting speeds that up. Farms spawn quartz-like accounts, porous under pressure, while the lagoon of daily participants witnesses genuine work.
